kb_status: COLD: the domain knowledge base did not exist at the start of this run, so there was no wiki page to reuse and no decisions.json to honour. Everything below was acquired fresh.

freshly_cloned.name: litellm
freshly_cloned.why: the closest production analogue: a real LLM gateway whose Router decides placement, quota pacing, retries, fallbacks, quarantine and per-caller budgets

freshly_cloned.name: routellm
freshly_cloned.why: the reference for quality-versus-price model selection and for how a selection threshold is calibrated

freshly_cloned.name: portkey-gateway
freshly_cloned.why: a second production gateway, config-driven: the contrasting design point on cross-request health memory, fallback chains and per-request timeouts

freshly_cloned.name: gaie
freshly_cloned.why: the strongest reference for placement under live load, saturation-driven admission control, request priority and cross-workload fairness on a shared fleet

freshly_cloned.name: llmrouterbench
freshly_cloned.why: the source of the measured per-prompt per-model quality scores and per-request dollars this task's ground truth is built from, and of its train/test protocol

shipped_contract.name: task-evaluator
shipped_contract.kind: shipped with the task, not a git clone
shipped_contract.why: the task ships the interface, the trusted-correct reference router, the baseline to beat and the scoring harness. It is the only authority on what a legal action is, so it is analysed and cited as a reference source in its own right; it does not substitute for the five clones above, which ground the design space around it.
